maddeler.e:
استصبرن (form X)
# اِسْتَصْبَرْنَ (istaṣbarna) /is.tasˤ.bar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# اُسْتُصْبِرْنَ (ustuṣbirna) /us.tusˤ.bir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# اِسْتَصْبِرْنَ (istaṣbirna) /is.tasˤ.bir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
